tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search CheapestInIndia for products sold in India, with live prices from Amazon, Flipkart, Croma, Reliance Digital, Myntra, Nykaa and other Indian retailers. tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for one CheapestInIndia product: current price, MRP, store, retailer rating, a price-history summary (lowest/highest ever, verdict), other variants at the same store, and similar products elsewhere. Use the id from search_products.

tools.name: lookup_product_by_url
tools.description: Find a product on CheapestInIndia from a retailer link the user pasted (Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Ajio, Croma, …) and return its tracked price, price-history summary, variants and similar products. Only products CheapestInIndia already tracks can be found.

tools.name: browse_categories
tools.description: List CheapestInIndia product category groups (id + name). Use an id as category_ids in search_products, or as category_id in top_price_drops. Optionally filter by a name fragment.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Price history and price check for a product sold in India, from CheapestInIndia's price tracking: current price, lowest and highest price ever (with dates), lowest in the last 7/30/90 days, how often the price changes, a price chart, and a factual verdict on where today's price sits.
